insights.insight: Crinkl has confirmed 83,017+ cryptographically verified receipts representing $4.47M in cumulative GMV — this is deterministic purchase proof, not modeled audience inference, across 17 active metro areas and 30 category/metro cells.

insights.topic: Category mix reveals true cookieless audience composition
insights.insight: Grocery-supermarkets (1,407 receipts, ~$39 avg basket) and restaurants-dining (1,175 receipts, ~$31 avg basket) together account for 51.5% of 14-day verified receipt volume, giving CPG and QSR brands a ground-truth category signal that no probabilistic panel can replicate.

Walmart leads at 371 verified receipts in the 14-day window, followed by Kroger (154), Costco (146), Publix (138), and Target (118) — brand marketers can benchmark verified in-store capture rates against named retail partners without relying on self-reported survey data.

insights.topic: Average basket compression signals category mix shift, not demand softness
insights.insight: 14-day average basket has compressed from ~$48 to ~$38.41 as lower-ticket categories (dining, coffee-fast-casual at ~$21.56 avg) gain receipt share; brands targeting higher-basket categories like gas-convenience (~$40.37, essentially flat) should weight their targeting accordingly.

insights.topic: Intraday purchase timing is measurable at the receipt level
insights.insight: Afternoon hours (UTC 12:16–16:16) consistently produce the largest intraday receipt accumulation — the 2026-09-29 window added 66 receipts and $2,377 in 7-day GMV in a single 4-hour block — giving media planners a verified daypart signal tied to actual transactions rather than clickstream proxies.

insights.topic: Receipt accumulation pace is accelerating structurally
insights.insight: Net receipt intake has run at approximately 450 receipts per day over the past 100 days, up from the prior monitoring window's 360–380/day pace; week-over-week deceleration (0.785x velocity) is itself decelerating (1.034x acceleration factor), suggesting the data asset is still in growth phase rather than plateau.
